free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month; delayed news data; HTTPS included; no historical data or commercial use
resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier_limits: Auditor correct. Official pricing (https://mediastack.com/pricing) lists Free plan features as 100 Calls/mo, Delayed News Data, HTTPS Encryption — not HTTP-only. Historical Data and Commercial Use appear only on paid tiers (Standard+). Older third-party writeups still say HTTP-only; official page wins.
